description: Toy Box Friends batch 3, second set: octopus, grasshopper and a tadpole with legs; dice (1 to 6 and a 0 to 5 classroom die) and dominoes with set pips and blank halves; a hand for counting; a hatching egg; fence, carrot, thermometer, door, skateboard, stopwatch; a heart cutaway and air sacs; berry bush, banana plant, milkweed, bean seed cutaway and open pod, butterfly egg; blender, measuring cup, juice carton, conveyor belt; padlock, hammer, paintbrush, ticket, token, prize ribbon, clapperboard, toy crane, oil can, story card, bell and puzzle pieces. Same part format as models.json.

octopus.description: A friendly purple octopus (O is for octopus), 0.9 m tall: a big round head with a smile and pink spots, and eight soft arms with pink tips curling out on the floor all round (all named "arm", gently waving). Works on the floor or under the sea.

grasshopper.description: A friendly green grasshopper 0.75 m long (head at +z): a long striped body, see-through-green roof wings ("wing", mirrored), long antennae, four little front legs and two big folded jumping legs ("leg", mirrored: the thigh and shin turn together about the hip). For food chains: Sun, grass, grasshopper, frog, hawk.

tadpole_legs.description: A tadpole growing back legs (frog life-cycle stage between tadpole and froglet): the round brown tadpole with big eyes and a long swishing tail ("tail"), plus two little kicking back legs with webbed sandy feet ("legs", mirrored). Swims at about 0.4 m.

die_1.description: A big soft red toy die (a 0.6 m rounded cube) with white dots in the standard patterns, showing one (1) on the front (+z). The other faces are a real die's (opposite faces add up to 7): top 2, right 3, back 6, left 4, bottom 5. Each face's dots are named by face ("front", "top", "right", "back", "left", "bottom") for highlights. Turn the die to [-90, 0, 0] to put the front face on top for a top-down shot.

die_2.description: A big soft red toy die (a 0.6 m rounded cube) with white dots in the standard patterns, showing two (2) on the front (+z). The other faces are a real die's (opposite faces add up to 7): top 1, right 4, back 5, left 3, bottom 6. Each face's dots are named by face ("front", "top", "right", "back", "left", "bottom") for highlights. Turn the die to [-90, 0, 0] to put the front face on top for a top-down shot.

The other faces are a real die's (opposite faces add up to 7): top 1, right 2, back 4, left 5, bottom 6. Each face's dots are named by face ("front", "top", "right", "back", "left", "bottom") for highlights. Turn the die to [-90, 0, 0] to put the front face on top for a top-down shot.

Each face's dots are named by face ("front", "top", "right", "back", "left", "bottom") for highlights. Turn the die to [-90, 0, 0] to put the front face on top for a top-down shot.

Each face's dots are named by face ("front", "top", "right", "back", "left", "bottom") for highlights. Turn the die to [-90, 0, 0] to put the front face on top for a top-down shot.

The other faces are a real die's (opposite faces add up to 7): top 2, right 3, back 1, left 4, bottom 5. Each face's dots are named by face ("front", "top", "right", "back", "left", "bottom") for highlights. Turn the die to [-90, 0, 0] to put the front face on top for a top-down shot.

die_blank.description: A big soft red classroom die for 0 to 5 (a 0.6 m rounded cube): the front (+z) is the blank zero face (no dots), the top shows 1, the right 2, the left 3, the bottom 4 and the back 5. Dots are named by face ("top", "right", "back", "left", "bottom"). Turn it to [-90, 0, 0] to put the blank face on top.

domino_0_0.description: A big domino standing on its short end, facing +z, 0.49 m tall, like the batch 3 `domino`: a blank half (zero) on the top half and a blank half (zero) on the bottom (0 in all). Each half and its pips are named ("top_half", "bottom_half") so they can light up or pull apart.

domino_0_1.description: A big domino standing on its short end, facing +z, 0.49 m tall, like the batch 3 `domino`: a blank half (zero) on the top half and 1 pip on the bottom (1 in all). Each half and its pips are named ("top_half", "bottom_half") so they can light up or pull apart.

hand.description: A big friendly open hand (0.88 m tall) standing on a blue cuff, palm to the viewer, five spread fingers for counting and skip counting by fives. Fingers are named "thumb" (on the viewer's right, +x), "index", "middle", "ring", "pinky": turn one to [80, 0, 0] to fold it down. Recolor "sand" for another skin tone.

egg_top.description: A cream egg 0.48 m tall that hatches: its top shell (named "top", hinged at its left rim) lifts off to show a zigzag cracked edge on the bottom shell ("bottom"). Turn <id>#top to [0, 0, 70] to tip it open, or move it [0, 0.15, 0] to lift it; a chick can pop out (cue the "crack" sound).

fence.description: One white picket fence section, 1 m long (one grid unit at size 1), 0.7 m tall, facing +z: five pointed pickets (the end ones are posts) on two rails. Line copies up end to end for a garden or a perimeter; recolor "white" to "wood" for a farm fence.

carrot.description: A big orange carrot standing point down, 0.65 m tall with its green leafy top (named "leaves", gently swaying). Sink it into the soil (y about -0.35) to show carrots growing in rows.

thermometer.description: A big toy thermometer 0.96 m tall on a blue foot: a clear glass tube on a white scale board with nine tick marks, a red bulb and a red liquid column (named "liquid", top at 0.76 m). Move <id>#liquid down (to [0, -0.19, 0] at most) for colder or up ([0, 0.1, 0] at most) for warmer; add a callout for the reading ("37.0 °C").

door.description: A toy door 1.1 m wide and 2.15 m tall in a wooden frame, facing +z: a blue door with two sky-blue panels and a gold knob, hinged on its left edge (named "door"). Turn <id>#door to [0, -90, 0] to swing it open toward the viewer ([0, -45, 0] for a half-open angle lesson).

skateboard.description: A toy skateboard 0.82 m long along x: an orange deck with rounded ends and a yellow star (named "deck"), grey trucks and four mint wheels (named "wheel": turn <id>#wheel by [0, 360, 0] to spin them). Tilt the deck with a turn about z to show angles.

stopwatch.description: A big toy stopwatch 0.62 m tall on a little foot, facing +z: a teal case with a grey rim, a white face with 12 tick marks and one red hand (named "hand", pointing up at rest: turn <id>#hand to [0, 0, -360] for one lap, clockwise) and a start button on top ("button": move it [0, -0.02, 0] to press).

heart_cutaway.description: A toy heart cut open (no gore, bright toy colours), 0.95 m tall on a grey stand, facing +z: on the front, four chambers as soft pockets: "right_atrium" and "right_ventricle" (sky blue, on the viewer's left, -x) and "left_atrium" and "left_ventricle" (rose, on the viewer's right), with cream valve flaps between top and bottom chambers ("valve_r" on the viewer's left, "valve_l" on the right; open them with turn <id>#valve_r [0, 0, -60] and <id>#valve_l [0, 0, 60]) and a red "septum" wall down the middle. On top: the red "aorta" and the blue "vena_cava" and "pulmonary_artery".

air_sacs.description: A close-up toy model of the lungs' air sacs (alveoli), 0.95 m tall on a grey stand: a cream airway ("airway") branches into three grape-like clusters of shiny pink sacs ("sacs") with a red and a blue capillary loop ("capillaries") wrapped round. Oxygen goes in, carbon dioxide comes out.

berry_bush.description: A round green berry bush 1.1 m wide and 0.8 m tall, dotted with eleven shiny red berries (named "berries"). A producer in food chains (birds and bears eat the berries).

banana_plant.description: A banana plant 1.7 m tall: a thick green stem, seven big arching leaves, a bunch of yellow bananas pointing up (named "bananas") and a purple flower bud hanging below them. A producer for warm-place food chains.

milkweed.description: A milkweed plant 1.05 m tall (the monarch butterfly's food plant): a green stem with pairs of broad pale sage-green leaves and three round clusters of tiny pink flowers on top (named "flowers"). Put a butterfly egg or a caterpillar on it.

bean_seed_cutaway.description: A big bean seed cut open (0.52 m long, lying along z, 0.25 m tall), in two halves: "left" and "right", each a pale yellow cotyledon (stored food) inside a sandy seed coat rim; the left half holds the tiny baby plant (two green leaves and a cream root) on its inner face. At rest the halves are closed: open it like a book with turn <id>#left [0, -75, 0] plus move [-0.14, 0, 0], and turn <id>#right [0, 75, 0] plus move [0.14, 0, 0], so both inner faces look at the camera.

bean_pod_open.description: An open green bean pod 0.8 m long along x: the bottom half ("bottom_half") holds four cream bean seeds ("seeds") on its pale lining, and the top half ("top_half") is opened back on a hinge along its back edge. Turn <id>#top_half to [115, 0, 0] to close it.

butterfly_egg.description: A tiny butterfly egg (butterfly life-cycle stage 1) on a milkweed leaf: the leaf lies flat, 0.6 m long, and the ridged cream egg (named "egg", 7 cm tall) sits on it near the middle. Use size 1 to 2 for a close-up.

blender.description: A toy blender 0.76 m tall: a teal motor base with three buttons, a clear glass jar with a handle and little blades (named "jar") and a charcoal lid ("lid": move it [0, 0.15, 0] to lift it off). Fill the jar with fruit for smoothies and fraction recipes.

measuring_cup.description: A clear measuring cup 0.3 m tall with a red handle, a little spout and red marks on the front at one quarter, one half and three quarters full (the half mark is longest). Fill it with a water shape that grows.

juice_carton.description: A juice carton 0.5 m tall: a white box with an orange band and an orange-fruit picture on the front, a gable top with a fin and an orange screw cap on the front slope (named "cap"). Add a letter "1 L" in front for volume lessons.

conveyor_belt.description: A factory conveyor belt 2.1 m long along x and 0.77 m tall: a charcoal belt (named "belt", its top at 0.77 m) over eight shiny grey rollers ("roller": turn <id>#roller by [0, 360, 0] to spin them), yellow side rails and grey legs. Boxes travel along the top with path.

padlock.description: A big shiny toy padlock 0.42 m tall: a gold body with a keyhole and a grey shackle (named "shackle"). To unlock: move <id>#shackle [0, 0.07, 0], then turn it [0, -110, 0] so it swings open about its left leg.

hammer.description: A toy hammer 0.56 m tall standing on its handle end: a wooden handle with a red grip and a grey metal head with a round striking face (+x) and a split claw (-x). Turn the whole prop about z to tap.

paintbrush.description: A big toy paintbrush 0.64 m tall standing on its handle: a red handle, a silver band and sandy bristles with a blue paint tip (named "tip"; recolor "blue" for another paint colour).

ticket.description: A ride or show ticket 0.5 m wide and 0.3 m tall standing on its edge, facing +z: a cream card with red lines and a red star, a dotted tear line and an orange stub (named "stub": move it to tear it off). Put a letter "TICKET" or a price in front.

token.description: A play-money token: a yellow disc 0.3 m across standing on its rim, facing +z, with an orange star on both faces and a ring of white dots. For markets, needs and wants and saving games.

prize_ribbon.description: A first-prize rosette 0.48 m tall standing on its two blue tails, facing +z: a pleated blue and sky-blue ring round a yellow centre with a white star. Pin it on a winner (parent it) or pop it in for a well done.

clapperboard.description: A film clapperboard 0.5 m wide standing on its edge, facing +z: a charcoal board with chalk lines and a striped hinged clapper on top (named "clapper", open at rest). Turn <id>#clapper to [0, 0, -18] to clap it shut (cue "clink").

toy_crane.description: A yellow toy crane 1.9 m tall: a base on charcoal tracks, a turntable, a red cab with a window, a tall mast and a jib arm with a counterweight (named "arm", pivoting on the mast top at x 0.1, y 1.6) and a cable with a red hook ring under the arm tip at x 1.04 (named "hook", it pivots on the same point). To swing, turn both <id>#arm and <id>#hook by the same [0, angle, 0]; to lower the hook, move <id>#hook [0, -0.2, 0] at most. A word block can hang from the hook (parent it to the hook part).

oil_can.description: A little red oil can 0.4 m tall (a toy, for the Needs and Wants Market and the Tin Man fix-ups): a round can with a cone top, a long gold spout pointing up and right (+x) and a gold handle.

story_card.description: A picture card 1.2 m wide and 0.9 m tall standing on two orange feet, facing +z: a cream card in an orange frame with a yellow number badge in the top-left corner (named "badge"; parent a letter to it). Put a small scene of shrunken objects 0.1 to 0.3 m in front of it (z 0.1 to 0.3) for First, Next, Then, Last.

bell.description: A shiny gold bell 0.82 m tall hanging from a wooden frame, facing +z: the bell and its clapper (named "bell", pivoting at the top bar) swing when you wiggle or turn it ([0, 0, 20] and back), with the "bell" sound. The end of a marble or domino run.

puzzle_pair.description: Two big jigsaw pieces standing side by side, facing +z, 0.4 m tall and 0.84 m wide together: a blue left piece with a tab (named "left") clicked into the matching notch of a yellow right piece ("right"). Move <id>#right [0.3, 0, 0] (and <id>#left [-0.3, 0, 0]) to pull them apart, back to [0, 0, 0] to click them together (cue "pop"). Rhyme pairs: put a word in front of each. Labels: parent a letter to the piece with part "left" or "right"; its at is measured from that piece's middle and scales with the prop's size, so a letter of size 0.1 centres on the face at [0, -0.05, 0.035] (baseline half an x-height below the middle, just in front of the 0.03 face). Both halves stay whole when moved apart (each name moves all its blocks).
